title: TEST FIXTURE: Anti-lock Brakes and Electronic Stability Control
text:
## Anti-lock Braking System
An anti-lock braking system keeps the wheels from locking during hard braking so the driver can keep steering control.
## Electronic Stability Control
Electronic stability control detects loss of steering control and brakes individual wheels to help keep the vehicle headed where the driver intends. ABS helps when braking hard; stability control helps during skids and sharp turns.
